title: Chandra Chakori
desc: Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.
A gangster deploys two of his trusted men in different cities to extort money from people who have escaped. While on their mission, they find themselves in various adventurous situations.

title: Gurudev Hoysala
desc: Gurudev Hoysala, a morally upright police inspector, is transferred to Athani to investigate a fellow officer's disappearance. However, a suspicious young couple soon complicates the case.

title: Appana Preethiyalli
desc: While on his deathbed, a businessman tells his family about a cunning man who stole most of his wealth. Hearing his father's revelation, the youngest son lays out a plan to seek revenge.

title: Triple Riding
desc: A man falls in love with the daughter of a rich business. However, his life turns into chaos when he pretends to be a doctor to help her friend escape an arranged marriage.
